newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products end mostly stronger, fuel oil off.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products end mostly stronger, fuel oil off.

text.p: NWE oil products ended mainly stronger on Friday with only fuel oil losing value.
Spot naphtha prices were firmer, lifted by stronger crude and gasoline markets and tight Mediterranean supplies.
Saudi gasoline buying following hefty sales of naphtha into Japan and an open arbitrage for gasoline to the United States were also seen helping to strengthen naphtha prices, traders said.
Gasoline was propelled higher in afternoon trading by healthy gains in NYMEX unleaded futures coupled with buying into a Saudi import tender.
Gas oil charged up to $5 a tonne higher on the back of firmer IPE futures and stronger premiums which were prompted by tightening supplies.
Fuel oil was weaker with over-supply and poor demand weighing on the market. High sulphur cargoes were down $2 a tonne. Low sulphur was supported by thin prompt supply.
